dhp100:4:
upasammati → sahasumapi vācānāmanaphapadasaṁhitā 
ekā aphavatī śreyā yaṁ śrætvā upaśāmyatī (bj: mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa); sahasa bi ya vaśana anatha pada sahita 
eka gadha pada ṣebha ya ṣutva uvaśamati (bj: prā. dhā. c. 72)
dhp101:4:
upasammati → sahasramapi gāthānāmanaphapadasaṁhitā 
ekā aphavatī śreyā yaṁ śrætvā upaśāmyati (bj: mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa)
dhp102:2: anatthapadasaṁhitā → anatthapadasaṁhitaṁ (bj); anatthapadasañhitā (sya-all) | anatthapadasaṁhitā → anatthapadasañhitaṁ (ka.) visesanaṁ hetaṁ gāthātipadassa (cck note)
dhp102:4:
upasammati → ja gadha śata bhaṣe anata pada sahita. 
eka gadha pada ṣebho ya ṣūtva uvaśamati (bj: prā. dha. c. 10)
dhp103:4:
saṅgāmajuttamo → yo śatāni sahasrāṇāṁ saṁgrāme manujān jayet. 
yo caikaṁ jayedātamānaṁ sa vai saṁgrāmajīdavaraඃ (bj: mahāvastu 3, 436 piṭa); yo sahasa sahasanī sagamī manuṣa jīni. 
eka ji...... atamana so ho sagamu utamu (bj: prā. dha. c. 6)
dhp106:6:
hutaṁ → varṣe varṣeśvamedhena yo yajate śataṁ samāඃ 
māṁsāni ca na bādedyasatayoඃ puṇyaphalaṁ samam (bj: manu. v. 53); yo yajena sahasrāṇāṁ māse māse śatāśatam 
na so buddhe prasādasya kalāmarghati ṣoḍaśim (bj: mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa); masi masi sahasina yo yaeva śatena ca 
nevi budhi prasadasa kala aveti ṣoḍaśa (bj: prā. dha.)
dhp107:6:
hutaṁ → yo ca varṣaśataṁ jivedaganiṁ paricaranśacaret 
patrāhāro chamāvāsī karonto vividhaṁ tapam. 
yaśvaikaṁ bhāvitātmānaṁ muhūrtamapi pūjayet 
sa ekā pūjanā śreyo na ca varṣaśataṁ hutam (bj: mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa); ya ja vaṣa śata jatu agi pariyara vane 
........ sa pi telena diva ratra atadrita 
eka ji bhavitatmana muhūtaviva puae 
sayeva puyana ṣebha yajī vaṣa śata hotu (bj: prā. dha. C. 20, 21)
dhp108:4:
seyyo → seyyā (bj) | ujjugatesu → ujugatesu (sya-all) | seyyā → yat kiṁvidiṣṭaṁ ca hutaṁ ca loke 
saṁvattaraṁ yajati puṇyaprekṣo 
sarvaṁ hi taṁ na caturbhāgameti 
abhivādanaṁ ujjugateṣu śreyami (bj: mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa); ya kiji yiṭha va hota va loke.

abhivadana ujukateṣu ṣiho (bj: prā. dha. C. 22)
dhp109:4:
balaṁ → abhivādanaśīlasya nityaṁ vṛdedhāpasevinaඃ 
catvāri sampravarṭhante āyurvidyā yaśo balam (bj: manusmṛti 2.121); adhivadanaśilisa nica vṛḍhavasayino 
catvari tasa vardhati ayo kīrti subha bala (bj: prā. dha. C. 34.)
dhp110:4:
jhāyino → yo ca varṣaśataṁ jivedaduඃśīlo asamāhitaඃ 
ekāhaṁ jīvitaṁ śreyaඃ śīlavantasya dhyāyato (bj: mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa)
dhp112:4:
vīriyamārabhato → viriyamārabhato (bj); viriyaṁ ārabhato (sya-all) | daḷhaṁ → yo ca varṣaśataṁ jivet kuśido hīnavīryyavān 
ekāhaṁ jīvitaṁ śreyaඃ śīlavantasya dhyāyato (bj: mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa); ya ji vaṣa śata jivi kusidhu hinaviriyava 
muhutu jīvita ṣeha viriya arahato dāḍha (bj: prā. dha. C 17)
dhp113:4:
udayabbayaṁ → udayavyayaṁ (bj) | udayavyayaṁ → yo ca....... apaśyaṁ udayavyayam 
....... paśyato udayavyayam (bj: mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa); ya ji vaṣa śata jivi apaśu udakavaya 
muhuta jivita ṣehu paśato udakavaya (bj: prā. dha C 18)
dhp114:4:
padaṁ → yo ca....... apaśyaṁ amātaṁ padam 
......... paśyato amātaṁ padam (bj: mahāvastu. 3. 436 piṭa)
dhp115:4:
dhammamuttamaṁ → yo ca ......... apaśyaṁ dhammuttamam 
...... paśyato dhammamuttamam (bj: mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa); ya ja vaṣa śata jīvi apaśu dhamu utamu 
muhuta jīvita sehu paśatu dhamu utamu (bj: prā. dha. G. 19)
